about_the_game:
UNLEASH THE RAGDOLL MAYHEM

🔥 SURVIVORS-LIKE IN 3D. WITH PHYSICS. LOTS OF PHYSICS.

You wanted survivors-like game with actual weight and chaos? You got it.

Hundreds of undead charging at you. Every kill sends bodies flying through the air. Enemies crash into each other. They damage their own allies. They throw themselves at you like suicidal projectiles. The battlefield transforms into a beautiful disaster of colliding skeletons, exploding zombies, and physics-driven carnage.

⚡ WHAT MAKES IT INSANE

🎯 RAGDOLL PHYSICS EVERYWHERE

Enemies don't just disappear when they die. They LAUNCH. They collide. They create chain reactions. Bodies pile up so high you'll be fighting on mountains of corpses.

💥 FRIENDLY FIRE CHAOS

Your enemies are idiots. They hurt each other. They knock each other down. A single strong hit can send a skeleton flying into 20 of his friends. Let them do your job for you.

🚀 ENEMIES AS PROJECTILES

Some undead literally throw themselves at you to deal damage. Dodge them, and watch them crash into their allies instead. It's chaos. It's beautiful. It's addictive.

🎮 PURE SURVIVORS DNA

Auto-aim combat. Wave-based survival. Power-up builds. Increasing difficulty. All the dopamine of VS, now with full 3D mayhem and bodies flying everywhere.

🎪 THE EXPERIENCE

00:00 - First wave. Easy. A few skeletons.
05:00 - Bodies everywhere. Chain reactions starting.
10:00 - Absolute chaos. Can't see the ground anymore. Just bones.
15:00 - You're fighting on a literal mountain of ragdolled corpses.
20:00 - Transcendence. You are become death, destroyer of physics engines.

💬 WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

"It's like someone gave the game a physics degree and anger issues."

"I've never been so satisfied watching skeletons accidentally murder each other."

"My PC fan sounds like a jet engine. 10/10."

🎯 THE BOTTOM LINE

If you've ever wanted to see 1000 ragdoll bodies fly through the air while you mow down undead hordes with auto-firing weapons...

If you've ever thought "VS needs MORE chaos"...

If the phrase "enemies damage each other with physics" makes you smile...

This is your game.

💀 BODIES WILL FLY. WILL YOU SURVIVE? 💀

short_description: Survivors-like in full 3D with ragdoll physics. Enemies throw themselves at you as projectiles, crash into allies, and damage each other. Bodies fly. Chaos reigns. Survive waves of undead in the most satisfying horde-slaughter you've ever seen. 🔥💀
